claim: merge-guard lets `gh pr merge 42` through when the only comment naming the PR's current head has its 'Reviewed at <sha>' line third, below two other lines of text.
why: REVIEWED in merge-guard/scripts/merge-guard.js is /^[#>*\s]*Reviewed at\s+`?([0-9a-f]{7,40})\b/im, and the m flag lets ^ match at the start of any line, so reason() returns null, which means allow, for the comment 'Thanks for the fixes.\nAll threads answered.\nReviewed at <head>' (a node script that calls reason() with a stub view printed '-> null' for that body and for the first-line form, and a deny for a stale sha and for 'LGTM', twice on fresh exports of the pin). The obvious check reads merge-guard/SKILL.md, which says the merge is allowed only when a comment or review opening with Reviewed at <sha> names the head, the header comment that code-review-grill opens each summary with that line, and the ^ anchor, and concludes that the line must come first. merge-guard.test.js uses only summaries whose first line is the Reviewed at line, so running it passes without touching this case.

root.claim: reason() allows the merge when 'Reviewed at <head>' is the third line of the only matching comment

atoms.claim: The REVIEWED pattern can match a line other than the first
atoms.evidence: merge-guard.js line 7: const REVIEWED = /^[#>*\s]*Reviewed at\s+`?([0-9a-f]{7,40})\b/im; the m flag makes ^ match after every newline.

atoms.claim: reason() returns null for that comment when its sha is the head
atoms.evidence: node script calling reason() with view returning headRefOid a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f9012345678 and one comment 'Thanks for the fixes.\nAll threads answered.\nReviewed at a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f9012345678' printed -> null; with 'LGTM' it printed the deny 'PR 42 has no "Reviewed at <sha>" summary'.
